DC Power Supply¶

This is the DC Power Supply class for the Siglent power supplies and all relevant subclasses.

dc_power_supply_siglent.DCPowerSupply(instrument)

Class for controlling the a DC Power Supply instrument.

dc_power_supply_siglent.Channel(instrument, ...)

Channel to be selected.

dc_power_supply_siglent.Current(instrument, ...)

Change and get the current of the selected channel.

dc_power_supply_siglent.Voltage(instrument, ...)

Change and get the voltage of the selected channel.

dc_power_supply_siglent.Power(instrument, ...)

Change and get the power of the selected channel.
